comment: unixmain.c:221-304, the attempt_restore loop after role.c genl_player_setup()'s "Not yet; choose another name". Segment 0 saves Vic. Segment 1 picks a new character at the saved-games menu, lets the game choose the role, and renames the hero to "Wes", who has no save: iflags.renameinprogress sends main() back to attempt_restore, restore_saved_game() opens nothing, selection is skipped (plsel_once) and the chosen role starts a new game. Segment 2, with !selectsaved, picks a role by hand and renames the hero to "Vic": the second attempt restores Vic's game and the chosen role is discarded. Segment 3 shows that restore deleted the save: "Vic" starts a new game.
